title: BusinessObjects Scheduled Job Failures
dataSources: MicroStrategy DSSErrors/statistics, Cognos audit database via DB Connect, BusinessObjects Auditing/CMS logs, Oracle Analytics usage tracking, ThoughtSpot audit logs, QuickSight CloudTrail and SPICE CloudWatch metrics.
app: MicroStrategy / IBM Cognos / SAP BusinessObjects / Oracle Analytics / ThoughtSpot / Amazon QuickSight logs via Universal Forwarder, vendor admin APIs, and cloud provider TAs (`Splunk_TA_aws` for QuickSight).
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=businessobjects:audit event_type=Schedule
| stats count as jobs, sum(eval(status IN ("Failed","Error"))) as failures by object_name
| where failures>0
| sort - failures
description: Tracks SAP BusinessObjects scheduled instances (Webi/Crystal) and flags failed jobs so recurring reports keep delivering.
value: Failed scheduled instances silently stop recurring reports; catching them keeps distributions reliable.
implementation: Ingest BO Auditing events or query the audit DB; schedule hourly; alert on failures.
visualization: Table of failing objects, timechart of job failures.
grandmaExplanation: We make sure scheduled BusinessObjects reports actually run and deliver, and flag the ones that fail.
